answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article dated 2026-07-01 reporting an NN, Inc. announcement made in late June 2026; the original NN release or filing was not in the supplied records.
answer.note: Source claim: NN, Inc. said in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of the new capacity pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and a 2026 target of US$80-US$90 million of accretive new business. For NVIDIA, this is a supply-chain lead, not a disclosed NVIDIA order: it suggests that NVIDIA rack liquid-cooling demand is pulling in dedicated Asian component capacity, and that suppliers see multi-year awards tied to that demand. The 100% pre-sold and US$80-US$90 million figures are company statements about NN's own business, so they support NN-side capacity commitments, not NVIDIA purchase volumes. The Russell Microcap removal and the analyst revenue and earnings projections to 2028 concern NN's equity and forecasts, not NVIDIA's supply or demand, and are given little weight here. If NN's awards are confirmed as being for NVIDIA-specified racks, the expansion would modestly support NVIDIA's rack-scale liquid-cooling supply base; if the awards run through rack integrators or other customers, the link to NVIDIA is weaker.
limitations: The NN statement's end customer is described only as 'NVIDIA AI data center racks'; the source does not name the buyers under the multi-year awards, so direct NVIDIA purchasing is not established.
The 100% pre-sold and US$80-US$90 million figures are NN company statements reported secondhand by Yahoo; no award values, counterparties, or contract terms were provided.
The original NN announcement date within late June 2026 is not given, and the original NN release or filing was not in the supplied records.
The NN revenue and earnings projections to 2028 are third-party narrative and unnamed-analyst estimates for NN, with no bearing on NVIDIA's own financials.
The Russell Microcap Value Index removal concerns NN's index membership and does not bear on NVIDIA's supply or demand.
No NVIDIA-side statement about NN, Wuxi capacity, or liquid-cooling suppliers was supplied, so NVIDIA's acknowledgment or dependence is unknown.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original late-June 2026 press release or 8-K and check whether it names NVIDIA as a customer or only refers to NVIDIA AI racks.
Check whether NN's Wuxi awards are with NVIDIA directly, with rack or server integrators, or with other data center customers, and whether any contract disclosure exists.
Search NVIDIA's latest 10-Q or 10-K and supplier disclosures for mention of liquid-cooling component suppliers, Asia capacity, or NN.
Track NN's subsequent quarterly filings for the status of the 47 machine centers (installation timing) and realized new-business revenue against the US$80-US$90 million 2026 target.
